64c806f2ad2b.english: Repeat the slice burst assay with the magnesium concentration reported, a d-APV arm and a GluN2B NAM arm, each at matched measured NMDAR-current reduction (one ifenprodil-site GluN2B NAM; a second NAM of the same site controls chemotype only, and only if its own maximum on triheteromers is known (ifenprodil 32 percent, radiprodil 45 percent in rat: each molecule has its own); compare with d-APV only up to the NAM's measured removable share; measure the d-APV abolition threshold x and the NAM removable fraction first), vehicle time-matched, animal as the unit; memantine only afterwards, with the magnesium concentration and holding voltage stated, beside the tool compound, and the untreated same-genotype comparator. [IT40] B6 Report bath magnesium, K+, temperature and blockers actually present as measured values; use a within-slice paired design; add an AMPA/kainate block arm verified by the fast EPSC (abolition alone is not informative, because loss of magnesium relief would abolish an NMDAR-regenerative burst too); add a matched-effect control read on at least two metrics with a receptor-agnostic release-reducing control; add a GABA-A arm because the sIPSC amplitude is halved; state the order of application and washout as part of the design. [SCI42] Report bath pH (and the buffer system) as a measured value with magnesium and potassium; read the percent of evoked synaptic charge removed for every drug so the matched drive-reduction control can be matched; a pH-dependent GluN2B tool is considered only after the tissue pH is measured, with the ifenprodil-site tool and d-APV at the same two pH values.

801774f5754a.english: A second scaffold (sharing a structural arrangement with ifenprodil-type ligands: inference from structure) read after the ifenprodil-site tool, to ask whether a different scaffold removes the same measured percent of the isolated NMDA-receptor current.
